replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged multiple attached terminal panes change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in multiple attached terminal panes; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Multiple attached terminal panes changes presentation or UI interaction only; stored claims and daemon wire contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by multiple attached terminal panes; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by multiple attached terminal panes.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
